.. change::
    :tags: bug, postgresql
    :tickets: 13636

    Fixed issue where the asyncpg dialect raised a plain :class:`.DBAPIError`
    for most PostgreSQL errors, instead of the PEP 249 subclass that matches
    the SQLSTATE class of the error.  A data exception (class 22) now raises
    :class:`.DataError` and a deadlock (class 40) raises
    :class:`.OperationalError`, the same classes psycopg uses.
